In the ferroelectric phase the same chains set a one-dimensional switching mechanism, in which the polarization reverses chain by chain.
summary: 几十年来，人们对铁电钙钛矿中的局部极性扭曲、它们的集体排序以及它们的场驱动反转进行了广泛的研究。在这里，我们利用大规模分子动力学和第一性原理训练的原子间势，发现了铁电卤化物钙钛矿 CsGeBr3 的异常行为。在其名义上的立方相中，Ge 偏心形成一维极性链，延伸至少数十纳米并在纳秒时间尺度上弛豫，比 BaTiO3 和 PbTiO3 慢四个数量级，CsSnBr3 位于其间。立方 CsGeBr3 相是一种动态无序状态，其中相反的极化链在整个晶体中翻转，并且长寿命的一维局部极化与零净极化共存。因此，简单的三维钙钛矿具有长程一维极相关性，并且动力学非常慢。在铁电相中，相同的链设置了一维切换机制，其中极化逐链反转。

title: Site and bond percolation thresholds of all $k$-uniform tilings with $k\le 10$
abstract: We determine the site and bond percolation thresholds of all 23,396 $k$-uniform tilings of the plane by regular polygons with $k\le 10$, the complete set according to the known enumeration. We use Monte Carlo simulation on tori and the condition that no wrapping and a cross-wrapping cluster are equally probable, the Monte Carlo form of the critical-polynomial criterion, which needs no knowledge of the large-scale anisotropy that most of these lattices have. The 486 thresholds with $k\le4$ have uncertainties of a few units in the sixth decimal and reproduce the 22 Archimedean reference values (rms deviation 0.71 standard errors) and unpublished bond thresholds of the 20 two-uniform lattices ($\chi^2=19.5$ for 20 values); the others have median statistical uncertainties of $2\times10^{-5}$ ($k\le7$) to $7\times10^{-5}$ ($k\ge8$) and no detectable finite-size bias. The vertex-type fractions alone fix the thresholds for $k\ge5$ to about $2\times10^{-3}$ (linear rule fitted on $k\le4$), while tilings with equal composition differ by up to $6\times10^{-3}$ (site) and $2\times10^{-2}$ (bond). In the range of domain sizes covered, descriptors of radius one account for more than half of this difference, and stackings of identical strips have thresholds linear in the fraction of each boundary type. For tilings that differ only by the registry of strips separated by $h$ rows of squares, the bond threshold difference decreases by a factor of 6-8 per row, comparable to the leading momentum-$\pi$ eigenvalue of the square-band transfer matrix.
summary:
我们通过 $k\le 10$ 的正多边形确定了平面上所有 23,396 个 $k$ 均匀平铺的位点和键渗透阈值，这是根据已知枚举的完整集合。我们对环面使用蒙特卡罗模拟，条件是无包裹和交叉包裹簇的可能性相同，即临界多项式准则的蒙特卡罗形式，它不需要了解大多数这些晶格所具有的大规模各向异性。 $k\le4$ 的 486 个阈值具有小数点后第六个单位的不确定性，并再现了 22 个阿基米德参考值（均方根偏差 0.71 标准误差）和 20 个二均匀晶格的未发布的键阈值（20 个值的 $\chi^2=19.5$）；其他的中值统计不确定性为 $2\times10^{-5}$ ($k\le7$) 到 $7\times10^{-5}$ ($k\ge8$)，并且没有可检测到的有限大小偏差。仅顶点类型分数将 $k\ge5$ 的阈值固定为约 $2\times10^{-3}$ （在 $k\le4$ 上拟合的线性规则），而具有相同成分的平铺最多相差 $6\times10^{-3}$ （站点）和 $2\times10^{-2}$ （键）。

在覆盖的域大小范围内，半径一的描述符占此差异的一半以上，并且相同条带的堆叠具有与每种边界类型的分数呈线性关系的阈值。对于仅由 $h$ 行正方形分隔的条带注册不同的平铺，键阈值差异每行减少 6-8 倍，与方带传输矩阵的主导动量 -$\pi$ 特征值相当。

title: Optimal Search Strategies under Finite Resource Constraints: The Role of Environmental Memory and Directional Information in Informed and Blind Protocols
abstract: Improving the efficiency of a stochastic search often requires to provide the searching agent with resources that modify its dynamics and help it explore space more quickly. Although such resources are often assumed to be unlimited and treated as a cost to mitigate, many realistic search processes operate under a finite resource budget, e.g. in processes with environmental memory in which the searcher deposits long-lasting cues along its path that it can interact with at later times to guide its further search. Here, we address the question of how to allocate a limited budget to maximize search efficiency by investigating a one-dimensional diffusing agent whose access to resources is constrained. We consider three resource models, namely an external force applied by an external controller to pull the searcher towards the target, directional flags deposited by the searcher along its path that redirect its motion towards the target, and self-generated chemorepulsive cues that act as a force field. For all these models, we find that resource usage should be concentrated in narrow regions of space when information about the searcher's current and past positions is available. In contrast, in blind strategies where a predefined time protocol is followed, resources should be used at a steady rate to ensure it to be used at most of its capacity by the time it reaches the target. We further show that blind strategies in non-Markovian processes with environmental memory are significantly less efficient due to the inherent fluctuations in the locations of deposited cues.
summary:
提高随机搜索的效率通常需要为搜索代理提供资源，以修改其动态并帮助其更快地探索空间。尽管此类资源通常被认为是无限的并被视为缓解成本，但许多实际的搜索过程在有限的资源预算下运行，例如在具有环境记忆的过程中，搜索者沿着其路径放置持久的线索，以便以后可以与之交互以指导进一步的搜索。在这里，我们通过研究对资源的访问受到限制的一维扩散剂来解决如何分配有限的预算以最大化搜索效率的问题。我们考虑三种资源模型，即外部控制器施加的外力将搜索器拉向目标，搜索器沿其路径放置的方向标记将其运动重定向到目标，以及充当力场的自生成化学脉冲线索。对于所有这些模型，我们发现当有关搜索者当前和过去位置的信息可用时，资源使用应该集中在狭窄的空间区域。

相比之下，在遵循预定义时间协议的盲目策略中，应以稳定的速率使用资源，以确保在达到目标时充分利用其容量。我们进一步表明，由于沉积线索位置的固有波动，具有环境记忆的非马尔可夫过程中的盲目策略的效率明显较低。

title: Graph-Recurrent Learning of Emergent Collective Dynamics
abstract: Collective ordering in correlated electron systems emerges from microscopic dynamics, yet the evolution of observable textures need not admit a closed, memoryless description. We introduce a graph-recurrent neural network (GRNN) framework that learns such emergent dynamics directly from trajectories without specifying microscopic equations of motion. The framework integrates gated recurrent memory with graph message passing: local hidden states encode information beyond the instantaneous observables, while spatial coupling allows this information to propagate between sites. The observable and hidden fields evolve jointly through a shared local rule, providing a scalable representation of dynamics with spatial interactions and temporal memory. We demonstrate this framework on the emergent dynamics of charge-density-wave order in the semiclassical Holstein model, successfully reproducing temporal and spatial correlations and dynamical scaling during domain coarsening. By learning finite-time evolution directly, the GRNN offers a route to efficient, data-driven descriptions of collective dynamics with unresolved microscopic degrees of freedom.
summary: 相关电子系统中的集体排序源于微观动力学，但可观察纹理的演化不需要接受封闭的、无记忆的描述。我们引入了一种图循环神经网络（GRNN）框架，该框架可以直接从轨迹中学习这种新兴动力学，而无需指定微观运动方程。该框架将门控循环内存与图形消息传递集成在一起：局部隐藏状态对超出瞬时可观察量的信息进行编码，而空间耦合允许该信息在站点之间传播。可观察场和隐藏场通过共享的局部规则共同演化，提供具有空间交互和时间记忆的动态的可扩展表示。我们在半经典荷斯坦模型中的电荷密度波阶的新兴动力学上证明了这个框架，成功地再现了域粗化过程中的时间和空间相关性以及动态缩放。通过直接学习有限时间演化，GRNN 提供了一种对具有未解决的微观自由度的集体动力学进行高效、数据驱动的描述的途径。

title: Sign-problem-free Bosonic Auxiliary Field Quantum Monte Carlo
abstract: The sign problem poses a fundamental barrier to numerically exact quantum Monte Carlo simulations, severely hindering our understanding of quantum many-body physics across disciplines ranging from condensed matter to particle and nuclear physics. Geometrical frustration makes this barrier especially acute for interacting bosons. Here, we develop a bosonic auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo (BAFQMC) method and rigorously prove that time-reversal symmetry and reflection positivity each provide a general sufficient condition for sign-problem-free simulations. Crucially, under either criterion, BAFQMC evades the sign problem even on frustrated lattices where conventional world-line and stochastic-series-expansion methods fail. Benchmarking our approach on a two-flavor Bose-Hubbard model on the triangular lattice yields excellent quantitative agreement with finite-temperature exact diagonalization. By establishing unifying principles to solve the sign problem in BAFQMC, our work substantially expands the reach of unbiased, numerically exact simulations for frustrated bosonic matter.
summary: 符号问题对数值精确的量子蒙特卡罗模拟构成了根本障碍，严重阻碍了我们对从凝聚态物理到粒子物理和核物理等跨学科的量子多体物理的理解。几何挫败使得这种障碍对于相互作用的玻色子来说尤其严重。在这里，我们开发了一种玻色子辅助场量子蒙特卡罗（BAFQMC）方法，并严格证明时间反转对称性和反射正性都为无符号问题模拟提供了一般充分条件。至关重要的是，在任一标准下，即使在传统世界线和随机级数展开方法失败的受挫格上，BAFQMC 也能避免符号问题。对三角晶格上的两种 Bose-Hubbard 模型的方法进行基准测试，得到了与有限温度精确对角化的良好定量一致性。通过建立统一原则来解决 BAFQMC 中的符号问题，我们的工作大大扩展了受挫玻色物质的无偏、数值精确模拟的范围。

title: Occupancy Driven Phase Transitions in Gapped Systems
abstract: Systems characterized by an energy gap between the ground state and excited states support a growing number of thermal excitations upon raising the temperature. Provided these excitations interact with each other, their number affects the size of the energy gap akin to a harmonic oscillator where the oscillation frequency is damping dependent. Here we show that once a critical number of excitations is reached, the excitation population becomes thermodynamically unstable and the system transitions between two states. This transition is marked by a divergence in the specific heat, which does not have to be accompanied by an order parameter, nor by the full closure of the gap. We illustrate the thermodynamics using a simple two level system and superfluid $^4$He as examples, and we argue that the hidden order transition in URu$_2$Si$_2$ is an example of such an occupancy driven transition in the absence of an order parameter.
summary: 以基态和激发态之间的能隙为特征的系统在温度升高时支持越来越多的热激发。如果这些激励相互作用，它们的数量就会影响能隙的大小，类似于谐振子，其中振荡频率取决于阻尼。在这里，我们表明，一旦达到激发的临界数量，激发群体就会变得热力学不稳定，并且系统会在两种状态之间转变。这种转变的标志是比热的发散，其不必伴随有序参数，也不必伴随间隙的完全闭合。我们使用简单的两级系统和超流体 $^4$He 作为示例来说明热力学，并且我们认为 URu$_2$Si$_2$ 中的隐藏顺序转换是在没有顺序参数的情况下这种占用驱动转换的示例。

title: Twisted scattering from Chern-Simons theory
abstract: We consider boundary conditions of two-dimensional Dirac fermions which preserve a non-anomalous continuous symmetry which acts differently on the left- and right-movers. Such boundaries are equivalent to topological defects of Weyl fermions preserving the symmetry. We give a general construction of such defects for conformally-embedded symmetries using Chern-Simons theory. They always exist and can be realised as half-space gauging defects for some finite categorical symmetry. Using this technology, we compute the twist lines to which fermions become attached upon scattering through the defect, the boundary central charge of the corresponding folded boundary state, and its mod-2 valued SPT class. As applications, we first consider abelian symmetries and find agreement with known results in the literature. We then study a novel example where an $SU(2) \times SU(4) \times U(1)^2$ symmetry is preserved. In contrast to the abelian case, the twist lines are intrinsically non-invertible and belong to either a $\text{TY}(\mathbb{Z}_3 \times \mathbb{Z}_3)$ or $\text{Rep}(\mathbb{S}_3) \times \mathbb{Z}_3$ symmetry depending on whether scattering is to the left or the right.
summary: 我们考虑二维狄拉克费米子的边界条件，它保留了非异常连续对称性，对左动子和右动子的作用不同。这样的边界相当于保持对称性的外尔费米子的拓扑缺陷。我们使用 Chern-Simons 理论给出了共形嵌入对称性的此类缺陷的一般构造。它们始终存在，并且可以作为某些有限分类对称性的半空间测量缺陷来实现。利用这项技术，我们计算了费米子在通过缺陷散射时所附着的扭曲线、相应折叠边界态的边界中心电荷及其 mod-2 值 SPT 类。作为应用，我们首先考虑阿贝尔对称性并发现与文献中已知结果的一致性。然后我们研究一个新的例子，其中 $SU(2) \times SU(4) \times U(1)^2$ 对称性被保留。与阿贝尔情况相反，扭曲线本质上是不可逆的，并且属于 $\text{TY}(\mathbb{Z}_3 \times \mathbb{Z}_3)$ 或 $\text{Rep}(\mathbb{S}_3) \times \mathbb{Z}_3$ 对称性，具体取决于散射是向左还是向右。

title: Finding CFTs from spatial positivity of partition functions
abstract: We discuss a positivity property for partition functions that generalizes modular invariance and which is here conjectured to hold for general 2D CFTs. We show its relation to positivity properties of Rényi entropies and its meaning in terms of topological defect lines. We apply the conjecture to find consistent local unitary CFT models which are not necessarily modular invariant.
summary: 我们讨论了配分函数的正性性质，该性质概括了模不变性，并且这里推测该性质对于一般的 2D CFT 成立。我们展示了它与 Rényi 熵的正性质的关系及其在拓扑缺陷线方面的含义。我们应用该猜想来寻找一致的局部酉 CFT 模型，该模型不一定是模不变的。

title: Collinear Gluons from Gravity: Poincaré-Birkhoff-Witt Decomposition and Twisted Intersections
abstract: We give an explicit reconstruction of subleading collinear Yang--Mills amplitudes from one-graviton amplitudes in Einstein--Yang--Mills theory and its string corrections. We realize the monodromy kernel in the mixed open-closed string relation as a weighted Lie-algebraic recursion on words of gluon labels. At order $\alpha'^r$, its output contains at most $r$ Lie factors. The Poincaré--Birkhoff--Witt (PBW) theorem decomposes the space spanned by gluon orderings into sectors whose dimensions are given by unsigned Stirling numbers of the first kind. Appropriate shuffle sums of one-graviton amplitudes extract the degree-$r$ sector, for which the string-period matrix drops out. Accordingly, we show that the reconstruction coefficients factor into linear kinematic factors over the product of bipartition factors. Finally, we express the reconstruction coefficients as twisted intersection numbers between Parke--Taylor forms and explicit forest cocycles constructed recursively from logarithmic four-point differentials.
summary: 我们根据爱因斯坦-杨-米尔斯理论中的一引力子振幅给出了次主导共线杨-米尔斯振幅的显式重构及其弦修正。我们将混合开闭串关系中​​的单峰核实现为胶子标签词的加权李代数递归。在 $\alpha'^r$ 阶上，其输出最多包含 $r$ 个谎言因子。庞加莱-伯克霍夫-威特 (PBW) 定理将胶子序所跨越的空间分解为扇区，扇区的尺寸由第一类无符号斯特林数给出。对一引力子振幅进行适当的洗牌和提取度 $r$ 扇区，弦周期矩阵将在该扇区中消失。因此，我们表明重建系数因二分因子的乘积而分解为线性运动学因子​​。最后，我们将重构系数表示为 Parke-Taylor 形式和从对数四点微分递归构造的显式森林余循环之间的扭曲交集数。

title: Reentrant $d=2+1$ Superfluidity at High Temperature
abstract: We present a UV-complete model with a global $U(1)$ symmetry in $d=2+1$ dimensions that exhibits a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) ordered phase at arbitrarily high temperatures. A careful separation of scales yields a two-dimensional Euclidean effective field theory whose construction remains perturbatively controlled even when its soft modes become strongly coupled. We determine the BKT phase boundary by carefully matching this theory to existing lattice Monte Carlo results. The high-temperature phase supports gapless static modes and algebraically decaying correlations even as $T\to\infty$.
summary: 我们提出了一个在 $d=2+1$ 维度上具有全局 $U(1)$ 对称性的 UV 完全模型，该模型在任意高温下表现出 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) 有序相。仔细的尺度分离产生了二维欧几里得有效场理论，即使其软模式变得强耦合，其结构仍保持微扰控制。我们通过将该理论与现有晶格蒙特卡罗结果仔细匹配来确定 BKT 相界。高温阶段支持无间隙静态模式和代数衰减相关性，甚至为 $T\to\infty$。

title: Defect flows from functional relations in the asymptotic semiring
abstract: We study perturbations of topological defects by a relevant holomorphic defect field in two-dimensional conformal field theory. This produces translation invariant defects and these necessarily flow to topological defects in the infrared. Translation invariant defects form a monoidal category which extends the fusion category of topological defects. We argue that the renormalisation group flow defines a semiring homomorphism from the semiring of translation invariant defects to an "asymptotic semiring" which we construct from topological defects. The semiring homomorphism preserves functional relations, and we illustrate in the example of Virasoro minimal models that the resulting relations in the asymptotic semiring constrain the defect flow endpoints. The companion paper [1] contains a detailed study of such defect flows in several minimal models, both numerically and analytically.
summary: 我们研究二维共形场理论中相关全纯缺陷场对拓扑缺陷的扰动。这会产生平移不变缺陷，并且这些缺陷必然会导致红外拓扑缺陷。平移不变缺陷形成了一个幺半群范畴，它扩展了拓扑缺陷的融合范畴。我们认为重正化群流定义了从平移不变缺陷的半环到我们从拓扑缺陷构造的“渐近半环”的半环同态。半环同态保留了函数关系，我们在 Virasoro 最小模型的例子中说明了渐近半环中的结果关系限制了缺陷流端点。配套论文 [1] 包含对几个最小模型中此类缺陷流的详细研究，包括数值和分析。

title: From bulk flows to boundary generators and costs
abstract: Holographic complexity admits a broad family of bulk observables, yet their relation to boundary state-preparation costs remains unclear. We propose a local prescription that associates suitable bulk observables with quadratic cost geometries on families of states prepared by Euclidean sources. Building on the holographic transport of bulk Hamiltonian flows to Euclidean preparation sources, we use the Hessian of the transported generator at a stationary reference state to define a candidate cost metric. When this Hessian is positive definite, the minimised preparation energy reproduces the change in the bulk observable to quadratic order. We characterise the resulting preparation penalties relative to the Fubini-Study metric and compute them for the maximal volume in scalar perturbations of AdS$_3$. At large-conformal dimension, we recover the known proportionality between cost and Fubini-Study metrics. At finite dimension, we obtain positive but generally unequal penalties for source variations that displace the bulk field and its conjugate momentum, breaking this proportionality even for a single scalar operator. We further study a deformation of volume by quadratic scalar and gradient terms in the large-dimension regime, determining how the couplings modify the penalties and constrain positivity. These additions selectively change field-displacement costs, with the gradient term introducing mode dependence. Our results provide an explicit local connection between the choice of bulk observables and the assignment of boundary preparation penalties.
summary:
全息复杂性承认大量可观测量，但它们与边界状态准备成本的关系仍不清楚。我们提出了一种局部处方，将适当的批量可观测量与由欧几里德来源准备的状态族的二次成本几何相关联。基于批量哈密顿流到欧几里德准备源的全息传输，我们使用固定参考状态下传输生成器的 Hessian 矩阵来定义候选成本度量。当该 Hessian 矩阵为正定时，最小化准备能量将可观察到的整体变化再现为二次阶。我们描述了相对于 Fubini-Study 指标产生的准备惩罚，并计算 AdS$_3$ 标量扰动中的最大体积。在大共形维度上，我们恢复了成本和 Fubini-Study 指标之间的已知比例。在有限维度上，我们对取代体场及其共轭动量的源变化获得正的但通常不相等的惩罚，即使对于单个标量算子也打破了这种比例性。

我们进一步研究大维区域中二次标量和梯度项引起的体积变形，确定耦合如何修改惩罚和约束正性。这些添加选择性地改变了场位移成本，梯度项引入了模式依赖性。我们的结果提供了批量可观测量的选择和边界准备罚分的分配之间的明确的局部联系。

title: 3D de Sitter from complex Virasoro TQFT: Observers and knots
abstract: The Euclidean saddles of 3D Einstein gravity with positive cosmological constant are spherical three-manifolds. When one adds a heavy observer, the backreacted saddles are spherical cone manifolds, with a conical singularity along the observer worldline. We propose exact gravitational partition functions at fixed topology on a class of spherical cone manifolds that undergo hyperbolic-to-spherical transitions as the cone angles increase. Our construction relies on a careful analytic continuation of the product of two Virasoro TQFT partition functions. We test the proposal by showing that the exact partition functions exponentiate in the semiclassical limit to the spherical volume, in agreement with the gravitational on-shell action. This leads to a spherical volume conjecture for the product of continued Virasoro TQFT amplitudes. As further evidence, we relate the theta and tetrahedron graph amplitudes to the two-point function and out-of-time-ordered four-point function of operators on a massive observer's worldline. In appropriate limits, we recover the static patch scalar two-point function with finite observer backreaction and the semiclassical effects of observer recoil. In addition, we analyze examples with knotted worldlines and reproduce their spherical volumes. We also apply our prescription to Seifert manifolds, which are off-shell in AdS$_3$ gravity but admit dS$_3$ saddles, and find agreement with their spherical volumes semiclassically. Finally, using Dehn surgery on torus knots and links, we obtain partition functions on smooth spherical three-manifolds.
summary:
具有正宇宙学常数的三维爱因斯坦引力的欧几里得鞍点是球面三流形。当添加一个重观察者时，反作用鞍座是球锥流形，沿着观察者世界线有一个圆锥奇点。我们在一类球锥流形上提出了固定拓扑下的精确引力分配函数，随着锥角的增加，球锥流形经历双曲到球面的转变。我们的构造依赖于两个 Virasoro TQFT 配分函数乘积的仔细分析延续。我们通过证明精确的配分函数在球体体积的半经典极限内求幂来测试该提议，这与壳上引力作用一致。这导致了连续 Virasoro TQFT 振幅乘积的球形体积猜想。作为进一步的证据，我们将 theta 和四面体图振幅与大型观察者世界线上算子的两点函数和无序四点函数相关联。在适当的限制下，我们恢复了具有有限观察者反作用和观察者反冲的半经典效应的静态补丁标量两点函数。

此外，我们还分析了具有打结世界线的示例并重现了它们的球形体积。我们还将我们的处方应用于 Seifert 流形，该流形在 AdS$_3$ 重力下处于壳外，但承认 dS$_3$ 鞍座，并半经典地找到与其球体积的一致性。最后，通过对环面结和连杆进行 Dehn 手术，我们获得了光滑球面三流形上的配分函数。

title: Big Crunching Your Big Bang: Doubly Warped Time-Dependent Type II Flux Backgrounds and Scale Separation
abstract: We construct three analytic, doubly warped cosmological solutions of massless type IIA supergravity with different choices of fluxes, namely, $H_3$, $\tilde F_2$ and $\tilde F_4$ along internal directions. The $H_3$ solution also belongs to the common NS--NS sector of type IIB. Our solutions show that, without localised sources, nonconstant warping on a smooth compact space is possible. We derive their eleven-dimensional uplifts and four-dimensional Einstein-frame cosmology. Each universe undergoes (decelerating) expansion from a Big Bang, reaches a maximum size, and undergoes contraction towards a Big Crunch. We also analyse the scale separation of these backgrounds and find that they exhibit a small Einstein frame Hubble scale to KK mass ratio $\frac{|H_E|}{m_{\mathrm{KK}}}\ll1,$ although for a brief period of time, around the maxima of the scale factor in the Einstein frame. Finally, we analyse the supersymmetry of these backgrounds, which demonstrates that all three solutions break all forms of type IIA supersymmetry.
summary: 我们构造了三个解析的、具有不同通量选择的IIA型超引力的双扭曲宇宙学解，即沿着内部方向的$H_3$、$\tilde F_2$和$\tilde F_4$。 $H_3$解决方案也属于IIB类型的公共NS--NS扇区。我们的解决方案表明，如果没有局部源，平滑紧凑空间上的非恒定扭曲是可能的。我们推导出它们的十一维隆起和四维爱因斯坦框架宇宙学。每个宇宙都会从大爆炸开始（减速）膨胀，达到最大尺寸，然后经历大收缩的收缩。我们还分析了这些背景的尺度分离，发现它们表现出较小的爱因斯坦坐标系哈勃尺度与 KK 质量比 $\frac{|H_E|}{m_{\mathrm{KK}}}\ll1,$ 尽管在很短的时间内，在爱因斯坦坐标系中比例因子的最大值附近。最后，我们分析了这些背景的超对称性，这表明所有三种解都打破了 IIA 型超对称性的所有形式。

title: Pressure in Wilsonian effective field theory
abstract: We study the exponential rolling tachyon solution in Wilsonian effective field theory as a model for rolling tachyons in open string field theory. Although this solution exhibits runaway oscillations towards the future similar to its counterparts in string field theory, its pressure is shown to be consistent with the underlying bare theory, but only up to a finite time. The rest of the evolution of the pressure is instead governed by a solution that is oscillatory towards the past and regular at late times. We conjecture that the late time physics of rolling tachyons in open string field theory may be captured by the solutions that are different from the standard rolling tachyon solutions based on this analysis.
summary: 我们研究威尔逊有效场论中的指数滚动快子解作为开弦场论中滚动快子的模型。尽管该解表现出与弦场理论中的对应解类似的面向未来的失控振荡，但其压力被证明与基础裸理论一致，但仅限于有限时间。相反，压力演变的其余部分是由一个解决方案控制的，该解决方案在过去是振荡的，在后期是规则的。我们推测，开弦场理论中滚动快子的晚期物理可能通过与基于此分析的标准滚动快子解不同的解来捕获。

title: Fluids on null hypersurfaces and Carrollian hydrodynamics
abstract: We study intrinsic ideal fluids on null hypersurfaces and their realisations by causal fluids living in the ambient spacetime. An embedded null hypersurface is equipped with an induced Carrollian structure with a temporal Weyl symmetry inherited from rescalings of the null generator, and we develop the corresponding null submanifold and variational calculus. The intrinsic fluid phases are classified according to their realisation of Carroll boosts and temporal Weyl symmetry. If we demand that an ambient fluid be confined to a null hypersurface, the ambient fluid velocity must be null, which realises an intrinsic zero-temperature Carrollian phase with unbroken Carroll boosts. In general, timelike or null ambient fluids will cross a null hypersurface and lead to an open Carrollian system. On a null foliation, the sources correspond to transport between null leaves. We then show that there exists a decoupling limit of a timelike ambient fluid which gives rise to an autonomous Carrollian fluid with spontaneously broken Carroll boosts and no source terms. This decoupling limit corresponds to an infinite boost while keeping the enthalpy finite and nonzero, which leads to a divergent ambient energy-momentum tensor. Nevertheless, the induced Carrollian responses do not see the divergent term and remain finite, and an independent Carroll boost Goldstone emerges from a subleading component of the ambient fluid velocity in this limit.
summary:
我们研究零超曲面上的固有理想流体及其通过生活在周围时空中的因果流体的实现。嵌入式零超曲面配备了诱导卡罗尔结构，该结构具有从零生成器的重新缩放继承的时间 Weyl 对称性，并且我们开发了相应的零子流形和变分微积分。固有流体相根据卡罗尔增强和时间韦尔对称性的实现进行分类。如果我们要求环境流体被限制在零超曲面内，则环境流体速度必须为零，这实现了具有不间断卡罗尔增强的固有零温卡罗尔相。一般来说，类时或零环境流体将穿过零超曲面并导致开放的卡罗尔系统。在零叶上，源对应于零叶之间的传输。然后我们证明，类时环境流体存在解耦极限，该极限会产生具有自发破坏的卡罗尔增强且没有源项的自主卡罗尔流体。

这种解耦极限对应于无限提升，同时保持焓有限且非零，这导致发散的环境能量动量张量。然而，诱导的卡罗尔响应看不到发散项并保持有限，并且独立的卡罗尔增强戈德斯通从该限制中的环境流体速度的次主导分量中出现。

title: Maxwell-Chern-Simons-Matter in AdS$_3$
abstract: We study Maxwell-Chern-Simons theory on AdS$_3$ coupled to $N$ complex scalars or Dirac fermions, including sextic and Gross-Neveu interactions, respectively. First, we derive the bulk Maxwell-Chern-Simons propagator, clarifying how Dirichlet boundary conditions fix the contributions of the massive and flat sectors. Upon coupling to the matter sector, we work at large $N$ with $\kappa=k/N$ and $\alpha=Ne^2$ fixed, where $k$ is the Chern-Simons level. We determine the corresponding phase diagrams, and we resum matter insertions to obtain the photon propagator at leading order in large $N$, exactly in $\alpha$ and $\kappa$. Its poles determine the spin-one boundary spectrum, split into two helicity sectors by the Chern-Simons interaction. With Dirichlet boundary conditions, the unHiggsed scalar phase contains a protected chiral current, which is lifted by Higgsing. In the fermionic phases, the current persists for nonzero effective Chern-Simons level, with helicity determined by the induced level shift. At bulk conformal points, we extract large-$N$ BCFT data for the critical and tricritical scalar theories, as well as for the regular fermion and Gross-Neveu theories.
summary: 我们研究 AdS$_3$ 与 $N$ 复标量或狄拉克费米子耦合的麦克斯韦-陈-西蒙斯理论，分别包括六次相互作用和 Gross-Neveu 相互作用。首先，我们推导了块体麦克斯韦-陈-西蒙斯传播器，阐明了狄利克雷边界条件如何确定块体扇区和扁平扇区的贡献。在耦合到物质部门后，我们在大$N$上工作，$\kappa=k/N$和$\alpha=Ne^2$固定，其中$k$是Chern-Simons能级。我们确定相应的相图，并恢复物质插入以获得大$N$中的前导顺序的光子传播器，恰好在$\alpha$和$\kappa$中。它的极点决定了自旋一边界谱，通过陈-西蒙斯相互作用分成两个螺旋扇区。在狄利克雷边界条件下，非希格斯标量相包含受保护的手性电流，该电流被希格斯效应提升。在费米子相中，电流持续存在于非零有效 Chern-Simons 能级，其螺旋度由感应能级位移决定。在体共形点，我们为临界和三临界标量理论以及常规费米子和 Gross-Neveu 理论提取大 $N$ BCFT 数据。

title: A tale of three points: mixed and tensor bispectra beyond leading order in Horndeski gravity
abstract: We derive the primordial $\langle\zeta\zeta h\rangle$, $\langle\zeta hh\rangle$, and $\langle hhh\rangle$ bispectra in general Horndeski theory through first order in slow variation, retaining their complete momentum and helicity dependence. The calculation includes the time evolution of the cubic coefficients, the correction to the scale factor, the first-order scalar and tensor mode functions, and the corrected power-spectrum normalization. We verify the tensor-soft and scalar-soft Maldacena consistency relations at the same order. We also study finite squeezing and show that, when $c_S\neq c_T$, the relevant soft variable is the ratio $c_Tq/(c_Sk)$, leading to an acoustic crossover not captured by geometric squeezing alone. We construct the corresponding nonlinearity parameters and apply the general results to a nonsingular contracting model, in which the mixed bispectra retain sensitivity to the contraction parameter through the scalar propagation speed.
summary: 我们通过慢变分的一阶推导了一般 Horndeski 理论中的原初 $\langle\zeta\zeta h\rangle$、$\langle\zeta hh\rangle$ 和 $\langle hhh\rangle$ 双谱，保留了它们完整的动量和螺旋度依赖性。计算包括三次系数的时间演化、比例因子的校正、一阶标量和张量模式函数以及校正的功率谱归一化。我们以相同的阶数验证张量-软和标量-软 Maldacena 一致性关系。我们还研究了有限压缩，并表明，当 $c_S\neq c_T$ 时，相关软变量是比率 $c_Tq/(c_Sk)$，导致声学交叉无法仅通过几何压缩捕获。我们构造了相应的非线性参数，并将一般结果应用于非奇异收缩模型，其中混合双谱通过标量传播速度保留对收缩参数的敏感性。

title: Data analysis of millions of Type IIB flux vacua
abstract: We study the vacuum structure of flux compactifications of type IIB string theory on the degree 18 hypersurface in $\mathbb{CP}^4_{1,1,1,6,9}$ with two effective complex structure moduli. We scan $30{,}770{,}178$ flux choices compatible with the tadpole bound, and use a gradient-based constrained minimization based on the SLSQP algorithm to identify candidates for local minima of the scalar potential, yielding a dataset of millions of candidate flux vacua. Using the $1{,}296{,}633$ reliable solutions selected from this dataset, we analyze distributions and correlations of various physical quantities such as vacuum expectation values of moduli and vacuum energy. Using quadratic flux invariants as input features, we train a classifier to identify solutions satisfying the numerical SUSY criterion $|V|<10^{-4.5}$. On a randomly selected test set, selecting the top-ranked $5\%$ recovers $47.2\%$ of the SUSY test solutions. We also use supervised regression to predict the potential and moduli field values. In the regression comparison, quadratic flux invariant inputs improve prediction of potential value and the complex-structure coordinates, while the vanilla six flux parameters give better predictions for the axio-dilaton coordinates under the tested settings.
summary:
我们研究了 $\mathbb{CP}^4_{1,1,1,6,9}$ 中 18 阶超曲面上具有两个有效复结构模量的 IIB 型弦理论通量紧致化的真空结构。我们扫描与蝌蚪边界兼容的 $30{,}770{,}178$ 通量选择，并使用基于 SLSQP 算法的基于梯度的约束最小化来识别标量势的局部最小值的候选者，产生数百万个候选通量真空的数据集。使用从该数据集中选择的 $1{,}296{,}633$ 可靠解决方案，我们分析了各种物理量的分布和相关性，例如模量和真空能量的真空期望值。使用二次通量不变量作为输入特征，我们训练分类器来识别满足数值 SUSY 准则 $|V|<10^{-4.5}$ 的解决方案。在随机选择的测试集上，选择排名最高的 $5\%$ 可恢复 $47.2\%$ 的 SUSY 测试解决方案。我们还使用监督回归来预测势场和模场值。

在回归比较中，二次通量不变输入改进了对势值和复杂结构坐标的预测，而普通六通量参数在测试设置下为轴膨胀坐标提供了更好的预测。

title: Quantum field theory and four-manifolds: Perspectives from physics and geometry
abstract: These lecture notes are based on lecture series by the authors for the Summer School 2025 on ``Physical mathematics of quantum field theory" at the University of Massachusetts Amherst organized by Owen Gwilliam, Chris Elliott, and Matteo Lotito. The lectures centred around algebraic structures arising from twists of supersymmetric quantum field theories, correlation functions of topologically twisted supersymmetric gauge theories, and their mathematical counterparts as intersection-theoretic invariants associated to moduli spaces of instantons, semistable sheaves, or Higgs sheaves on four-manifolds or complex projective surfaces.
summary: 这些讲稿基于作者在马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校举办的 2025 年暑期学校“量子场论的物理数学”系列讲座，由 Owen Gwilliam、Chris Elliott 和 Matteo Lotito 组织。这些讲座围绕超对称量子场论的扭曲产生的代数结构、拓扑扭曲的超对称规范理论的相关函数以及它们的数学对应物作为与模相关的交集理论不变量。四流形或复杂射影面上的瞬子、半稳定滑轮或希格斯滑轮空间。

title: Amplified EFT corrections near exceptional QNMs
abstract: We show that the ordinary expansion of EFT corrections to individual QNM frequencies breaks down at an exceptional QNM, and that these corrections become enhanced for near-exceptional QNMs. We give a brief argument for why this should generally happen, before numerically demonstrating this behaviour by calculating the $\alpha'^3$ corrections to QNMs of equal-spin Myers--Perry-AdS$_5$ black holes. This calculation corresponds to $\lambda^{-3/2}$ corrections to the poles of the retarded Green's function in the boundary CFT, where $\lambda$ is the 't Hooft coupling. Treating the coalescing pair together, we calculate the leading $\lambda^{-3/4}$ splitting at the uncorrected exceptional point and the $\lambda^{-3/2}$ displacement of the exceptional point in temperature and angular velocity. The background derivative expansion can remain valid while the nondegenerate expansion of individual frequencies fails. We discuss the implications for the full response and for other areas of black hole physics.
summary: 我们表明，EFT 校正对各个 QNM 频率的普通扩展在特殊的 QNM 中会崩溃，并且这些校正对于近乎特殊的 QNM 会得到增强。在通过计算对等自旋 Myers-Perry-AdS$_5$ 黑洞的 QNM 的 $\alpha'^3$ 修正来数值演示这种行为之前，我们给出了一个简短的论证，说明为什么这种情况通常会发生。该计算对应于边界 CFT 中延迟格林函数极点的 $\lambda^{-3/2}$ 修正，其中 $\lambda$ 是 't Hooft 耦合。将合并对一起处理，我们计算未校正异常点处的前导 $\lambda^{-3/4}$ 分裂以及温度和角速度异常点的 $\lambda^{-3/2}$ 位移。当各个频率的非简并展开失败时，背景导数展开可以保持有效。我们讨论了对完整响应和黑洞物理其他领域的影响。

title: The Stringy Photon Sphere
abstract: The S matrix on an asymptotically-flat Schwarzschild black hole is studied as a function of position on $\mathcal{I}$. We derive the lightcone singularities that arise in the S matrix whenever the two points on $\mathcal{I}$ are connected by a bulk null geodesic. This includes geodesics orbiting near the photon sphere for a long time, whose kinematics determine the associated lightcone singularities. By turning on a finite string length $\ell_s$, worldsheet corrections are shown to shift the lightcone singularities into the complex time plane, resolving the singularities at real times. In particular, we derive the leading stringy resolution of the photon sphere singularities. We also compute stringy corrections to the eikonal quasinormal mode spectrum of Schwarzschild, and discuss the kinematics of strings orbiting the photon sphere.
summary: 研究渐近平坦史瓦西黑洞上的 S 矩阵作为 $\mathcal{I}$ 上位置的函数。每当 $\mathcal{I}$ 上的两个点通过块空测地线连接时，我们就导出 S 矩阵中出现的光锥奇点。这包括在光子球附近长时间运行的测地线，其运动学决定了相关的光锥奇点。通过打开有限的字符串长度 $\ell_s$，世界表校正可以将光锥奇点转移到复杂的时间平面中，从而实时解决奇点。特别是，我们得出了光子球奇点的领先弦分辨率。我们还计算了史瓦西拟正模谱的弦校正，并讨论了绕光子球运行的弦的运动学。

title: Normal Matrix Model and Hyperelliptic Curves
abstract: We present a two-matrix model with a normal matrix with eigenvalues confined to contours in the upper half plane coupled to a Hermitian matrix. This generalizes the matrix model proposed by Jens Hoppe which corresponds to a single horizontal line. We solve the saddle point equations for several lines and show that the large-N free energy can be expressed in terms of hyperelliptic integrals. We show that the model describes a Coulomb gas in the presence of an infinite conducting boundary.
summary: 我们提出了一个双矩阵模型，其中法线矩阵的特征值仅限于与埃尔米特矩阵耦合的上半平面中的轮廓。这概括了 Jens Hoppe 提出的对应于单条水平线的矩阵模型。我们求解了几条线的鞍点方程，并表明大 N 自由能可以用超椭圆积分来表示。我们证明该模型描述了存在无限导电边界的库仑气体。

title: Higher-Loop Vacuum Integrals on $S^D$
abstract: We develop a new framework for evaluating higher-loop integrals for scalar fields on $S^D$. Starting from a Schwinger-parametric form for general higher-loop integrals on the sphere, it combines total-derivative identities with edge-contraction relations into a coupled linear system. To illustrate our method, we solve for all vacuum graphs through two loops. This includes, in particular, the two-loop three-melon, for which we construct the analytic solution for general $D$ and obtain explicit dimensionally regularized results at all integer dimensions.
summary: 我们开发了一个新的框架，用于评估 $S^D$ 上标量场的高循环积分。从球面上一般高环积分的施温格参数形式开始，它将全导数恒等式与边收缩关系组合成耦合线性系统。为了说明我们的方法，我们通过两个循环求解所有真空图。这特别包括二环三瓜，我们为它构造一般 $D$ 的解析解，并在所有整数维度上获得显式维度正则化结果。

title: TQFT gravity dual to the orbifold groupoid of Narain code CFTs over $\mathbb{Z}_4$
abstract: In a companion paper arXiv:2610.26610 , we classified the Narain conformal field theories obtained by gluing copies of the $A_3$ root and weight lattices along their $\mathbb{Z}_4$ discriminant group. For two hyperbolic pairs, this gives twenty-two even self-dual gluing codes, which fall into seven inequivalent theories at $c=\bar c=6$. In this paper, we develop the physical interpretation of this family and its connections to three-dimensional topological field theory. We show that all twenty-two codes are topological boundary conditions of a single abelian Chern-Simons theory. Its invertible symmetries, which include fractional $B$-field shifts, organize the boundaries into three orbits: free, mixed and torsion. Boundaries in different orbits are related only by gauging. We determine all gaugings of order at most four between the seven theories, by $\mathbb{Z}_2$, $\mathbb{Z}_4$ and $\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$, with explicit twisted partition functions, and follow their effect on the spectrum and the current algebra. We then sum the Chern-Simons partition function over handlebodies at genus one and prove a finite Siegel-Weil identity, valid for any number of pairs. For two pairs, the handlebody sum is the uniform average over the free theories. Recovering the average over all twenty-two theories requires one additional contribution, a solid torus with the torsion lines along its core. For three or more pairs, we find that the handlebody sum is not a positive combination of code boundary states.
summary:
在配套论文 arXiv:2610.26610 中，我们对通过沿着 $\mathbb{Z}_4$ 判别组粘合 $A_3$ 根格和权重格的副本获得的 Narain 共形场论进行了分类。对于两个双曲对，这给出了 22 个偶数自对偶粘合码，它们在 $c=\bar c=6$ 处落入七个不等价理论。在本文中，我们发展了该族的物理解释及其与三维拓扑场论的联系。我们证明所有二十二个代码都是单个阿贝尔陈-西蒙斯理论的拓扑边界条件。它的可逆对称性，包括分数$B$场位移，将边界组织成三个轨道：自由轨道、混合轨道和扭转轨道。不同轨道上的边界只能通过测量来关联。我们通过 $\mathbb{Z}_2$、$\mathbb{Z}_4$ 和 $\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$ 确定七个理论之间至多四阶的所有计量，并使用显式扭曲配分函数，并跟踪它们对频谱和当前代数的影响。然后，我们对属一处的手柄体上的 Chern-Simons 配分函数求和，并证明有限的 Siegel-Weil 恒等式，对任意数量的对都有效。

对于两对，手柄主体总和是自由理论的统一平均值。恢复所有二十二种理论的平均值需要一项额外的贡献，即一个其核心有扭力线的实心环面。对于三对或更多对，我们发现手柄体和不是代码边界状态的正组合。

title: Beyond the Fock Vacuum in Finite-$N$ Bilocal Algebras of Vector Models
abstract: We discuss the finite-$N$ Hilbert space of bilocal operators that underlies bilocal holography of vector models, beyond the sector built on the Fock vacuum. If the microscopic oscillator Fock space carries a multiplicity-free dual action of a compact color group $G$ and a bilocal algebra, Howe duality implies that projection to the derived subgroup $[G,G]$ selects precisely the characters of the abelianization $G^{\rm ab}=G/[G,G]$ that occur in the Fock space. Thus $O(N)/SO(N)=\mathbb Z_2$ gives two sectors, $U(N)/SU(N)=U(1)$ gives integer determinant-charge sectors, while $Sp(N)$ is perfect and gives no additional sector; Bose/Fermi statistics and the number of modes determine which sectors are actually realized. We construct the epsilon and determinant backgrounds that generate these sectors, together with their finite-$N$ constraints and Casimirs, and find that the two bosonic $O(N)$ sectors are not distinguished by any Casimir. Using group-integral projectors, we derive explicit sector-resolved characters for the $O(N)$ and $U(N)$ theories. Around each new background we solve the constraints with auxiliary oscillators, which form a Fermi sea for bosonic matter. In the free vector model on $\mathbb R\times S^2$ the new sectors consist of baryonic primaries; we determine their energies, degeneracies and spin content exactly at finite $N$, together with their lowest energy at fixed angular momentum.
summary:
我们讨论双局部算子的有限 $N$ 希尔伯特空间，它是矢量模型双局部全息的基础，超出了建立在福克真空上的扇区。如果微观振子 Fock 空间具有紧色群 $G$ 和双局部代数的无重数对偶作用，则豪对偶性意味着到派生子群 $[G,G]$ 的投影精确地选择出现在 Fock 空间中的阿贝尔化 $G^{\rm ab}=G/[G,G]$ 的特征。因此 $O(N)/SO(N)=\mathbb Z_2$ 给出两个扇区，$U(N)/SU(N)=U(1)$ 给出整数行列式电荷扇区，而 $Sp(N)$ 是完美的，没有给出额外的扇区； Bose/Fermi 统计数据和模式数量决定了实际实现的扇区。我们构建了生成这些扇区的 epsilon 和行列式背景，以及它们的有限 $N$ 约束和卡西米尔，并发现两个玻色子 $O(N)$ 扇区不能被任何卡西米尔区分开。使用群积分投影仪，我们得出 $O(N)$ 和 $U(N)$ 理论的显式扇区解析特征。围绕每个新背景，我们用辅助振荡器解决约束，这些辅助振荡器形成玻色子物质的费米海。

在 $\mathbb R\times S^2$ 上的自由矢量模型中，新扇区由重子原色组成；我们精确地确定了它们在有限$N$下的能量、简并性和自旋含量，以及它们在固定角动量下的最低能量。

title: A periodic $\bar q$ equation for form factors
abstract: MHV form factors of the chiral stress-tensor multiplet in planar $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang-Mills theory are dual to periodic null Wilson loops. We propose a periodic $\bar q$ equation for the MHV and higher-helicity sectors at vanishing fermionic monodromy. The equation relates kinematic derivatives of $\mathrm N^k\mathrm{MHV}$ form factors to collinear integrals of $\mathrm N^{k+1}\mathrm{MHV}$ form factors with one additional external particle, providing a recursive relation in loop order. In periodic momentum supertwistors, it has the same collinear-integral form as the two dotted components of the amplitude $\bar Q$ equation, with coefficient $\Gamma_{\rm cusp}/4$, despite the absence of ordinary dual conformal invariance at fixed operator momentum. For parity-even scalar MHV remainders, combining the equation with its parity image supplies all directions of the kinematic differential. We verify the equation analytically for the one-loop four-point NMHV form factor and reconstruct the two-loop three-point MHV remainder at function level. Further two-loop MHV tests give numerical agreement with derivatives of the known four-point remainder at a fixed kinematic configuration, and for five points, all six chiral derivatives agree exactly at symbol level for a one-parameter family of kinematics. The structure of the collinear source further gives all-loop predictions for MHV last entries, consistent with known results and form a space of dimension $n(2n-5)$. The periodic Wilson-loop picture also motivates an all-loop derivation. Using the form-factor OPE, we extract the one-loop correction to the fermion energy from the logarithmic source and recover its vanishing at zero momentum.
summary:
平面 $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang-Mills 理论中手性应力张量多重态的 MHV 形状因子与周期性空 Wilson 环对偶。我们提出了一个用于 MHV 和更高螺旋度扇区的周期性 $\bar q$ 方程。该方程将 $\mathrm N^k\mathrm{MHV}$ 形状因子的运动导数与 $\mathrm N^{k+1}\mathrm{MHV}$ 形状因子与一个附加外部粒子的共线积分相关联，从而提供循环顺序的递归关系。在周期性动量超扭曲中，它与振幅 $\bar Q$ 方程的两个点分量具有相同的共线积分形式，系数为 $\Gamma_{\rm cusp}/4$，尽管在固定算子动量下不存在普通的对偶共形不变性。对于奇偶校验标量 MHV 余数，将方程与其奇偶校验图像相结合可提供运动学微分的所有方向。我们分析验证了单环四点 NMHV 形状因子的方程，并在函数级别重构了两环三点 MHV 余数。

进一步的两环 MHV 测试给出了与固定运动学配置下已知四点余数的导数的数值一致性，并且对于五点，所有六个手性导数在单参数运动学族的符号级别上完全一致。共线源的结构进一步给出了 MHV 最后条目的全循环预测，与已知结果一致，并形成维度 $n(2n-5)$ 的空间。周期性威尔逊环图也激发了全环推导。使用形状因子 OPE，我们从对数源中提取对费米子能量的单环校正，并恢复其在零动量下的消失。

title: Surface Defects in the $\mathcal{N}=2$ Lens Space Index and Elliptic Integrability
abstract: We determine the surface-defect difference operators of the 4d $\mathcal{N}=2$ lens space index for class $\mathcal{S}$ theories of type $A_{N-1}$ on $(\mathbb{S}^3/\mathbb{Z}_r)\times\mathbb{S}^1$. For generic fugacities $(p,q,t)$ and arbitrary rank $N$, orbifold order $r$ and discrete holonomies, their coefficients are finite products of theta functions with nomes $p^r$ and $q^r$. After an explicit gauge transformation, Gaussian in the holonomies, each operator factorizes into two elliptic Ruijsenaars--Schneider-type operators with step $pq$, one with nome $p^r$ and one with nome $q^r$, acting on variables glued along a lattice. Using this factorization and a Wronski-type relation, we prove that all the operators commute. We also establish a sufficient criterion for self-adjointness with respect to the bilinear vector multiplet pairing. It applies to the basic mixed operator and, in suitable parameter chambers, to the pure $p$- and $q$-type operators; for general mixed operators the contour prescription remains open. These results support the expectations from S-duality.
summary: 我们确定 $(\mathbb{S}^3/\mathbb{Z}_r)\times\mathbb{S}^1$ 上 $A_{N-1}$ 类型 $\mathcal{S}$ 类理论的 4d $\mathcal{N}=2$ 透镜空间索引的表面缺陷差分算子。对于一般逸度 $(p,q,t)$ 和任意秩 $N$、轨道阶 $r$ 和离散完整函数，它们的系数是 theta 函数与 nomes $p^r$ 和 $q^r$ 的有限乘积。经过显式规范变换（全称中的高斯变换），每个算子分解为两个椭圆 Ruijsenaars——步长为 $pq$ 的施耐德型算子，一个带有 nome $p^r$，一个带有 nome $q^r$，作用于沿着格子粘合的变量。使用这种因式分解和 Wronski 型关系，我们证明所有运算符都是可交换的。我们还建立了关于双线性向量多重配对的自伴性的充分标准。它适用于基本混合算子，并且在合适的参数室中，适用于纯$p$-和$q$-类型算子；对于一般混合算子，轮廓处方保持开放。这些结果支持了 S-对偶性的期望。

title: Inverse KLT kernel of AdS string-amplitude building blocks from the intersection matrix
abstract: We develop a topological and combinatorial interpretation of the Kawai--Lewellen--Tye (KLT) relations for $n$-point AdS string-amplitude building blocks, which are disk integrals with multivariable multiple polylogarithm insertions and sphere integrals with their single-valued counterparts. Building on the framework of twisted de Rham theory over a noncommutative ring, we reformulate the problem in terms of associahedral chambers of the moduli space loaded with solutions of the Knizhnik--Zamolodchikov equation. We construct regularized twisted cycles and express their intersection pairings through local monodromies and Drinfeld associators, which control transport between fusion-tree normalizations. Organizing the intersection contributions by common boundary faces yields the intersection matrix, which is identified with the inverse KLT kernel by the twisted period relation. The field-theory limit of the inverse KLT kernel is also given.
summary: 我们为 $n$ 点 AdS 弦振幅构建块开发了 Kawai--Lewellen-Tye (KLT) 关系的拓扑和组合解释，这些构建块是具有多变量多重多对数插入的圆盘积分和具有单值对应项的球积分。基于非交换环上扭曲德拉姆理论的框架，我们根据加载了 Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov 方程解的模空间关联面体室重新表述了该问题。我们构建了正则化的扭曲循环，并通过局部单峰和 Drinfeld 关联器来表达它们的交叉配对，这些关联器控制着融合树标准化之间的传输。通过公共边界面组织交集贡献可生成交集矩阵，该矩阵通过扭曲周期关系用逆 KLT 核进行识别。还给出了逆 KLT 核的场论极限。

title: Phases of flux vacua and their quantum symmetries
abstract: We present a torsional linear sigma model with (0,2) supersymmetry that realizes, in its large radius phase, a five-dimensional heterotic flux vacuum, and we use the linear sigma model to connect this geometry to a stringy regime realized as an asymmetric orbifold of a Gepner model and a circle. Along the way we develop a number of tools relevant for more general (0,2) gauged linear sigma model constructions of heterotic vacua.
summary: 我们提出了具有 (0,2) 超对称性的扭转线性 sigma 模型，该模型在其大半径相中实现了五维异质通量真空，并且我们使用线性 sigma 模型将这种几何形状连接到作为 Gepner 模型和圆的不对称轨道折叠实现的弦态。在此过程中，我们开发了许多与杂种真空的更一般的 (0,2) 测量线性西格玛模型构建相关的工具。

title: Quasinormal modes, complex null geodesics and singularity resolution in regular AdS black holes
abstract: The black hole singularity is hidden behind its horizon, and it is difficult to determine whether it is resolved by quantum gravity or stringy effects. For an AdS-Schwarzschild black hole, it is known that the two-point function of the dual conformal field theory has a singularity associated with a null geodesic that bounces off the black hole singularity. In this paper, we investigate how the resolution of the black hole singularity is encoded in the dual conformal field theory by considering regular AdS black holes as regularized geometries. Using WKB analysis, we compute the quasinormal modes of regular AdS black holes and read off the dual two-point functions from the modes. We find that the singularity corresponding to the bouncing null geodesic for singular black holes is replaced by a smooth bump associated with a complex, rather than real, null geodesic. The location of the complex geodesic singularity is supported by analyzing the structure of the operator product expansion for the two-point function. Our results provide a holographic signature of black hole singularity resolution and clarify how information about the regular interior is encoded in boundary correlation functions.
summary:
黑洞奇点隐藏在视界后面，很难确定它是由量子引力还是弦效应解决的。对于 AdS-Schwarzschild 黑洞，已知双共形场论的两点函数具有与从黑洞奇点反弹的零测地线相关的奇点。在本文中，我们通过将规则 AdS 黑洞视为正则几何结构，研究了如何在双共形场论中编码黑洞奇点的分辨率。使用 WKB 分析，我们计算了常规 AdS 黑洞的拟正则模式，并从模式中读出了对偶两点函数。我们发现，与奇异黑洞的弹跳零测地线相对应的奇点被与复杂而非真实的零测地线相关的平滑凹凸所取代。通过分析两点函数的算子乘积展开的结构来支持复测地奇点的位置。

我们的结果提供了黑洞奇点分辨率的全息签名，并阐明了有关规则内部的信息如何编码在边界相关函数中。

title: Five-loop static two-body potential in massless scalar-tensor gravity
abstract: We compute the static contribution to the conservative two-body potential in massless scalar-tensor theories through fifth post-Newtonian (5PN) order, with the strong-field scalar responses of the compact objects encoded in scalar-dependent masses. Within post-Newtonian effective field theory (EFT), evaluating the 1PN-5PN static terms requires one- through five-loop massless two-point Feynman integrals. Although the additional scalar modifies both source couplings and integrand numerators, the required scalar master topologies remain those of the corresponding static problem in general relativity. Moreover, independent reflection symmetries of the two static scalar sectors extend the odd-PN factorization mechanism to the present theory, so that no genuinely new five-loop master integrals are required. Our results reproduce the known static interaction through 2PN, provide an independent EFT determination at 3PN, and extend the explicit potential to 4PN and 5PN. We verify the general-relativity limit and body-exchange symmetry; regulator poles and residual transcendental terms cancel in the complete result, leaving rational coefficients. These high-precision results provide ingredients for increasingly precise gravitational-wave tests of gravity beyond general relativity.
summary:
我们通过第五后牛顿（5PN）阶计算对无质量标量张量理论中保守二体势的静态贡献，以及以标量相关质量编码的致密物体的强场标量响应。在后牛顿有效场论 (EFT) 中，评估 1PN-5PN 静态项需要一到五环无质量两点费曼积分。尽管附加标量修改了源耦合和被积分子，但所需的标量主拓扑仍然是广义相对论中相应静态问题的拓扑。此外，两个静态标量扇区的独立反射对称性将奇 PN 分解机制扩展到本理论，因此不需要真正新的五环主积分。我们的结果通过 2PN 再现了已知的静态相互作用，提供了 3PN 上的独立 EFT 确定，并将显式势扩展到 4PN 和 5PN。我们验证了广义相对论极限和物体交换对称性；调节器极点和残余超越项在完整结果中抵消，留下有理系数。

这些高精度结果为超越广义相对论的日益精确的引力波测试提供了素材。

title: Small black hole in de Sitter as an observer
abstract: We study the Euclidean path integral around magnetically charged lukewarm black holes in four-dimensional de Sitter space. We numerically determine the full one-loop spectrum of coupled graviton and photon fluctuations and find that the phase of the partition function agrees with that of pure gravity in empty de Sitter plus a worldline observer. In the small-mass limit, certain localized eigenmodes can be effectively viewed as describing the observer's motion and have the expected eigenvalues, allowing us to reconstruct the worldline action. We further identify these modes with translational zero modes of an extremal charged black hole in asymptotically flat spacetime, lifted by de Sitter curvature.
summary: 我们研究四维德西特空间中带磁温黑洞周围的欧几里得路径积分。我们用数值方法确定了耦合引力子和光子涨落的完整单环谱，并发现配分函数的相位与空德西特加上世界线观察者中的纯引力相位一致。在小质量限制下，某些局部本征模式可以有效地视为描述观察者的运动并具有预期的本征值，使我们能够重建世界线动作。我们进一步将这些模式与渐近平坦时空中的极值带电黑洞的平移零模式识别，由德西特曲率提升。

title: Holographic surface defect RG flows without supersymmetry
abstract: We consider $\mathcal{N}=4$ supersymmetric Yang--Mills theory with gauge group SU$(N)$, which admits families of conformal surface defects defined by singular boundary conditions for scalar fields that completely break supersymmetry. At large $N$ and strong coupling, these defects are holographically dual either to a probe D5-brane or to one of two new D7-brane embeddings that we introduce in this work. We also construct embeddings of both D5- and D7-branes describing defect renormalisation group (RG) flows, for which the ultraviolet and infrared fixed points are both dual to the same D$p$-brane, with different values of a parameter. Our embeddings dual to RG flows are mostly constructed numerically, but we find a regime in which we can derive approximate analytic embeddings using a controlled perturbative expansion. We demonstrate that the $b$-theorem is satisfied by all of the RG flows that we study.
summary: 我们考虑具有规范群SU$(N)$的$\mathcal{N}=4$超对称Yang-Mills理论，它承认由完全打破超对称性的标量场奇异边界条件定义的共形表面缺陷族。在大 $N$ 和强耦合下，这些缺陷与探针 D5 膜或我们在这项工作中引入的两个新的 D7 膜嵌入之一全息对偶。我们还构建了描述缺陷重正化群（RG）流的 D5 和 D7 膜的嵌入，其中紫外和红外固定点都是同一 D$p$ 膜的对偶，具有不同的参数值。我们的 RG 流对偶嵌入大多是通过数值构建的，但我们找到了一种机制，可以使用受控的微扰展开来导出近似的解析嵌入。我们证明我们研究的所有 RG 流都满足 $b$ 定理。

title: Timelike Supersymmetric Geometries in Seven-Dimensional Supergravity
abstract: Seven-dimensional supergravity poses a uniquely intricate supersymmetry problem, combining topologically massive higher-form gauge dynamics, distinct Clifford algebra properties, and rich geometric structures. We first establish the complete formulation of the maximal Cartan-gauged theory in terms of the gauge-invariant higher-form flux, including both the bosonic action and supersymmetry variations. This formulation, which also makes the smooth ungauged limit manifest, is achieved by requiring a consistent truncation to the minimal Cartan-gauged theory in the equal-charge limit. We construct the complete bilinear system for a timelike Killing vector, where additional internal orientation of the symplectic-Majorana spinor arises already in the scalar sector, uniquely among pure minimal ungauged theories. In the equal-charge sector, we decouple the algebraic constraints into SU$(3)$-isotypic components, and analyse the differential bilinear relations, determining the permitted dilaton gradient, fluxes, fibration twist and intrinsic torsion of the base. We prove that with gauging and active Cartan flux, the complex scalar bilinear vanishes identically. We also construct a Killing gauge for the higher-form potential compatible with the self-duality condition. We show that with gauging but no active Cartan flux, the Killing vector also acts as a generator of the gauged R-symmetry, and the base structure is enlarged from SU$(3)$ to U$(3)$. We find that BPS-flow solutions realize this setting. With supersymmetry, we isolate a single independent component of the 3-form equation across an exhaustive four-class partition for both theories within this setup. Applied to known and proposed solutions in both theories, this classification exposes unexplored sectors and provides an accessible toolbox for constructing and testing solutions and developing new geometric and holographic applications.
summary:
七维超引力提出了一个独特复杂的超对称问题，结合了拓扑大规模的更高形式的规范动力学、独特的克利福德代数性质和丰富的几何结构。我们首先根据规范不变的高形式通量建立了最大嘉当规范理论的完整公式，包括玻色子作用和超对称变化。该公式也使平滑的非计量极限变得明显，它是通过要求对等电荷极限中的最小嘉当计量理论进行一致截断来实现的。我们为类时 Killing 向量构建了完整的双线性系统，其中辛马约拉纳旋量的附加内部方向已经出现在标量扇区中，这在纯最小非规范理论中是独一无二的。在等电荷部分，我们将代数约束解耦为 SU$(3)$ 同型分量，并分析微分双线性关系，确定允许的膨胀梯度、通量、纤维化扭曲和基底的固有扭转。我们证明，通过计量和主动嘉当通量，复标量双线性同样消失。

我们还构建了一个与自我二元性条件兼容的更高形式潜力的杀伤量表。我们表明，在计量但没有主动嘉当通量的情况下，杀伤矢量也充当计量 R 对称性的生成器，并且基础结构从 SU$(3)$ 扩大到 U$(3)$。我们发现 BPS-flow 解决方案实现了这一设置。通过超对称性，我们在该设置中的两种理论的详尽四类划分中隔离了 3 型方程的单个独立分量。该分类适用于两种理论中已知和提出的解决方案，揭示了未探索的领域，并提供了一个可访问的工具箱，用于构建和测试解决方案以及开发新的几何和全息应用。

title: String Amplitudes on Integer Rectangles
abstract: Hidden zeros of tree-level string amplitudes of colored scalars lie on loci specified by integer-valued dimensionless momentum contractions arranged in rectangles on the kinematic mesh. We study the same kinematic loci for open-string amplitudes with gluons, fermions and higher-spin states at arbitrary finite mass levels. Disk monodromy relations yield $\textit{zero-locus factorization}$: at regular points where the monodromy system is invertible, the amplitude is a weighted sum of physical three-point amplitudes sewn to complete on-shell $(n-1)$-point amplitudes. Hidden zeros follow when the external wavefunctions annihilate all contributing three-point couplings. In the low-energy limit, the massless zero-integer branch recovers the corresponding field-theory factorization. For closed strings, including gravitons, persistent cubic zeros in both chiral sectors remove the disk poles, allowing the Kawai--Lewellen--Tye momentum-kernel zero to imply amplitude zeros. The operator product expansions of external vertices give a common worldsheet origin for these conditions across spins and mass levels.
summary: 彩色标量的树级弦振幅的隐藏零点位于由排列在运动网格上矩形中的整数值无量纲动量收缩指定的轨迹上。我们研究了任意有限质量水平下胶子、费米子和高自旋态的开弦振幅的相同运动学轨迹。盘单向关系产生$\textit{零轨迹分解}$：在单向系统可逆的规则点处，振幅是缝合到完整壳上$(n-1)$点振幅的物理三点振幅的加权和。当外部波函数消除所有贡献的三点耦合时，就会出现隐藏的零点。在低能量极限下，无质量零整数分支恢复相应的场论因式分解。对于闭合弦，包括引力子，两个手性扇区中的持久立方零消除了圆盘极点，使得 Kawai--Lewellen--Tye 动量核零意味着振幅零。外部顶点的算子乘积展开为这些跨自旋和质量水平的条件提供了共同的世界表原点。

title: High precision black hole scattering
abstract: In this thesis we compute the impulse of a classical black hole scattering encounter in the Post-Minkowskian (PM) expansion - a weak-field expansion in Newton's constant $G$ - up to the fifth order. We describe the black holes as point particles within an effective field theory framework and couple them through gravity. The classical equations of motion are solved diagrammatically using the worldline quantum field theory (WQFT) formalism, in which the solution with causal boundary conditions is encoded in tree-level Feynman diagrams built from graviton and worldline fields. The Feynman integrals arising at each order are reduced by advanced IBP reduction techniques and evaluated with the method of differential equations. We find that, in the solution of these integrals, periods over Calabi--Yau manifolds - familiar from string theory - appear and contribute to the classical impulse at the fifth Post-Minkowskian order. The results of this work are the first analytic results for the scattering observables at fifth Post-Minkowskian order, together with the appearance of Calabi--Yau threefold periods in a classical physics observable.
summary: 在本论文中，我们计算了后闵可夫斯基 (PM) 展开（牛顿常数 $G$ 中的弱场展开）中高达五阶的经典黑洞散射遭遇的冲量。我们将黑洞描述为有效场论框架内的点粒子，并通过重力将它们耦合起来。经典运动方程使用世界线量子场论 (WQFT) 形式进行图解，其中具有因果边界条件的解被编码在由引力子和世界线场构建的树级费曼图中。每阶产生的费曼积分均通过先进的 IBP 简化技术进行简化，并使用微分方程方法进行评估。我们发现，在这些积分的解中，卡拉比（Calabi）上的周期（在弦理论中很常见）出现并有助于后闵可夫斯基第五阶的经典脉冲。这项工作的结果是第一个后闵可夫斯基五阶散射可观测量的分析结果，以及经典物理可观测量中卡拉比-丘三重周期的出现。

title: Monodromy Defects of 3D Wilson-Fisher Criticality on the Fuzzy Sphere
abstract: Monodromy (twist) line defects arise as the boundaries of topological symmetry surfaces, which are among the simplest non-trivial conformal defects with direct realizations as magnetic vortex in quantum magnets, as Wilson and t Hooft lines of gauge theories, and as the replica twist operators in quantum information theory. However, their interacting dynamics remains difficult to characterize non-perturbatively. Here we design a way to realize the monodromy boundary conditions in the fuzzy-sphere regularization by threading a symmetry-selective Aharonov-Bohm flux through the two poles of the sphere. We apply this construction to the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ twist of the 3D Ising conformal field theory (CFT), $\pi$-twist of the 3D O(2) CFT and three inequivalent monodromies of O(3) (centre twist, z-axis $\pi$-twist and the reflection). For each defect, we extract the low-lying defect spectrum together with bulk-to-defect and defect-defect operator product expansion coefficients, which characterize the operators living on the defect line, their mutual interactions, and how they couple to the surrounding critical bulk. Among the low-lying defect primaries resolved in our spectra, we find no relevant scalar perturbation that preserves all the symmetries of the corresponding defect. The relevant deformations identified in our calculations break at least one preserved symmetry, providing evidence that these monodromy defects are stable against symmetry-preserving relevant perturbations. These results establish a systematic set of non-perturbative conformal data for monodromy defects beyond the Ising twist. Our construction therefore turns the symmetry flux into a tunable knob of the fuzzy-sphere regularization, opening a route to exploring the response of critical matter to distinct defects.
summary:
单向（扭曲）线缺陷作为拓扑对称面的边界出现，是最简单的非平凡共形缺陷之一，可以直接实现为量子磁体中的磁涡流、规范理论中的威尔逊线和霍夫特线以及量子信息论中的复制扭曲算子。然而，它们的相互作用动态仍然难以非扰动地表征。在这里，我们设计了一种通过将对称选择性阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆通量穿过球体的两个极点来实现模糊球正则化中的单向边界条件的方法。我们将此构造应用于 3D Ising 共形场论 (CFT) 的 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 扭曲、3D O(2) CFT 的 $\pi$-扭曲和 O(3) 的三个不等价单峰（中心扭曲、z 轴 $\pi$-扭曲和反射）。对于每个缺陷，我们提取低位缺陷谱以及块体到缺陷和缺陷到缺陷算子乘积展开系数，这些系数描述了缺陷线上的算子、它们的相互作用以及它们如何与周围的临界块体耦合。

在我们的光谱中解析的低位缺陷原色中，我们没有发现相关的标量扰动可以保留相应缺陷的所有对称性。我们的计算中确定的相关变形破坏了至少一种保留的对称性，提供了证据表明这些单向缺陷对于保留对称性的相关扰动是稳定的。这些结果为伊辛扭曲之外的单峰缺陷建立了一组系统的非微扰共形数据。因此，我们的构造将对称通量转变为模糊球正则化的可调旋钮，开辟了一条探索关键物质对不同缺陷的响应的途径。

title: Exact stress-tensor generators distinguish integrable continuations
abstract: The same leading $T\bar T$ interaction can coexist with sharply different strong-field responses, even within causal, classically integrable sigma models. We reconstruct exact autonomous stress-tensor generators for prescribed one-scale Courant--Hilbert families in two dimensions. Separating the invariant stress scale from a signed trace ratio reduces reconstruction to one scalar inversion on each invertible physical branch. The resulting profile determines both the deformation law and the relation between local energy density and pressure. For generalized Born--Infeld and logarithmic models, the leading interactions coincide, yet pressure saturates in the former and grows without bound in the latter. Their exact generators are respectively quadratic and nonpolynomial, the latter involving Lambert $W_{-1}$. A regular Legendre transformation gives the same profile in the auxiliary potential formulation. The flows commute locally with root-$T\bar T$ within a common smooth branch and retain a common classical Lax form. Exact reconstruction thus quantifies the nonlinear freedom left by leading-order matching.
summary: 即使在因果、经典可积 sigma 模型中，相同的主导 $T\bar T$ 相互作用也可以与截然不同的强场响应共存。我们为规定的二维一尺度 Courant-Hilbert 族重建精确的自主应力张量生成器。将不变应力尺度与带符号的迹比分开，可将重建减少为每个可逆物理分支上的一次标量反转。所得轮廓决定了变形规律以及局部能量密度与压力之间的关系。对于广义的 Born-Infeld 模型和对数模型，主要相互作用是一致的，但压力在前者中饱和，而在后者中无限增长。它们的精确生成元分别是二次生成元和非多项式生成元，后者涉及兰伯特 $W_{-1}$。常规勒让德变换在辅助势公式中给出了相同的轮廓。这些流在公共平滑分支内与 root-$T\bar T$ 进行本地交换，并保留常见的经典 Lax 形式。因此，精确重建量化了前导匹配留下的非线性自由度。

title: Unitarity methods for Magnus amplitudes
abstract: Magnus amplitudes refer to the matrix elements of the logarithm of the $S$-matrix. Modern unitarity methods construct cut-constructible parts of scattering amplitudes without directly invoking Feynman diagrams, offering an efficient way of obtaining loop integrands for scattering amplitudes. A procedure is presented that adapts unitarity methods to the computation of Magnus amplitudes.
summary: 马格努斯振幅是指 $S$ 矩阵对数的矩阵元素。现代幺正性方法无需直接调用费曼图即可构造散射振幅的可割构造部分，从而提供了一种获取散射振幅的循环被积函数的有效方法。提出了一种采用酉法来计算马格努斯振幅的程序。

title: The classical two-loop amplitude at leading logarithmic accuracy for graviton emission in multi-Regge kinematics
abstract: Using the gravitational shockwave formalism, we compute the classical part of the $\mathcal{O}(G^{7/2})$ five-point amplitude at leading logarithmic accuracy describing the emission of a graviton in the collision of two massless scalars in multi-Regge kinematics (MRK). The result splits into a two-particle reducible term and a three-particle reducible one, the latter being the radiative counterpart of the $H$-diagram with the emission taken in MRK limit. The same amplitude can be equivalently calculated as the ultrarelativistic limit of the corresponding massive amplitude by applying the optical theorem according to the conjectured universality of the leading logarithmic amplitudes in classical gravity.
summary: 使用引力冲击波形式，我们以领先的对数精度计算 $\mathcal{O}(G^{7/2})$ 五点振幅的经典部分，描述了多 Regge 运动学 (MRK) 中两个无质量标量碰撞中引力子的发射。结果分为两个粒子可约项和一个三粒子可约项，后者是 $H$ 图的辐射对应项，其发射量取于 MRK 极限。根据经典引力中领先对数振幅的普遍性猜想，应用光学定理，可以等效地计算出相同的振幅作为相应质量振幅的超相对论极限。

title: Krylov Complexity and Entropy of Composite Quantum Systems
abstract: We investigate the behaviour of Krylov complexity as the number of degrees of freedom of a quantum system increases. Specifically, we show that for tensor products of commuting subsystems, the leading excess complexity is controlled by a weighted variance of the subsystem Lanczos coefficients. This provides a quantitative measure of dynamical heterogeneity and a precise characterization of synchronous evolution. We also show that Krylov entropy is able to disambiguate the information associated with subsystems composition from that generated by dynamical mismatch, and that the same Lanczos variance controls the leading mismatch contribution to both complexity and the entropy. Our results establish excess complexity and Krylov entropy as complementary probes of the emergence of collective dynamics in large quantum systems.
summary: 我们研究了随着量子系统自由度数量的增加，克雷洛夫复杂度的行为。具体来说，我们表明，对于通勤子系统的张量积，主要的过度复杂性是由子系统 Lanczos 系数的加权方差控制的。这提供了动态异质性的定量测量和同步进化的精确表征。我们还表明，克雷洛夫熵能够消除与子系统组成相关的信息与动态失配生成的信息的歧义，并且相同的兰佐斯方差控制着对复杂性和熵的主要失配贡献。我们的结果建立了过度复杂性和克雷洛夫熵作为大型量子系统中集体动力学出现的互补探针。

title: The Spectral Edge at Large Central Charge and Black Hole Statistics
abstract: We introduce a new approach to high-energy spectra in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$, addressing the open challenge of incorporating spectral statistics into the modular bootstrap. Using the analytic theory of $L$-functions attached to two-dimensional CFTs, we leverage modular constraints among high-energy states to derive a sum rule relating the spectral edge to bulk spectral fluctuations. As an application, we establish a refined modular bootstrap bound: letting $\Delta_1$ be the conformal dimension of the lightest excited Virasoro primary of a unitary CFT of central charge $c$, we show that $\Delta_1 - {c-1\over 12} \leq o(c)$, with at most one exceptional value of the scalar gap at each sufficiently large $c$; moreover, along any sequence in $c$ for which such exceptional gaps are realized, the remaining gaps obey the stronger bound $\Delta_1 - {c-1\over 12} \leq O(1)$. The result applies to theories with logarithmic rigidity of spectral counting fluctuations, as in random matrix theory.
summary: 我们在 AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ 中引入了一种新的高能谱方法，解决了将谱统计纳入模块化引导程序的开放挑战。利用附加到二维 CFT 的 $L$ 函数的解析理论，我们利用高能态之间的模块化约束来导出将光谱边缘与整体光谱波动相关的总和规则。作为一种应用，我们建立了一个精炼的模块化自举边界：令 $\Delta_1$ 为中心电荷 $c$ 的酉 CFT 的最轻激发 Virasoro 初级的共形维数，我们证明 $\Delta_1 - {c-1\over 12} \leq o(c)$，在每个足够大的 $c$ 处，标量间隙至多有一个异常值；此外，沿着 $c$ 中实现此类特殊间隙的任何序列，剩余间隙服从更强的界限 $\Delta_1 - {c-1\over 12} \leq O(1)$。该结果适用于具有谱计数波动的对数刚性的理论，如随机矩阵理论。

title: Exact Two-Loop Effective Potentials in de Sitter Space via Finite-Difference Methods
abstract: We compute the renormalised two-loop effective potential of the $O(N)$-symmetric scalar theory on four-dimensional de Sitter space. The main technical ingredient is the two-loop watermelon vacuum integral. Although a closed-form representation of this integral was previously available, extracting its finite part near four dimensions remained exceedingly difficult. We use exact finite-difference equations in the propagator spectral labels to obtain a representation in which the ultraviolet poles are isolated in Gamma-function factors and the remaining series are regular near four dimensions. We prove the boundary condition selecting the physical solution, extract the finite part, and combine the result with the tadpole reconstruction of the potential. The calculation includes the subtraction of subdivergences and the derivation of the matter-sector renormalisation-group functions. Holding the field-dependent masses and scalar curvature fixed makes the spectral labels regulator-dependent. We track this dependence explicitly and show that its derivative terms cancel after the forest subtraction. The resulting potential is exact in the mass-to-curvature ratios at two-loop order, away from propagator poles and subject to the usual limitations of perturbation theory. This is the first exact two-loop determination of the effective potential in four-dimensional de Sitter space.
summary:
我们计算四维德西特空间上 $O(N)$ 对称标量理论的重正化二环有效势。主要技术成分是二回路西瓜真空积分。尽管以前可以使用该积分的封闭形式表示，但在四个维度附近提取其有限部分仍然极其困难。我们在传播器光谱标签中使用精确的有限差分方程来获得一种表示，其中紫外线极点在伽马函数因子中被隔离，而其余系列在四个维度附近是规则的。我们证明了选择物理解的边界条件，提取有限部分，并将结果与​​势的蝌蚪重建相结合。计算包括子散度的减法和物质扇区重整化群函数的推导。保持与场相关的质量和标量曲率固定使得光谱标签与调节器相关。我们明确地跟踪这种依赖性，并表明其导数项在森林减法后取消。

由此产生的电势在两环阶的质量曲率比中是精确的，远离传播极并且受到微扰理论的通常限​​制。这是四维德西特空间中有效电势的首次精确两环确定。

title: Large $N$ hadron scattering bootstrap: massive pions and glueballs
abstract: We extend the large $N$ bootstrap of pion scattering to nonzero pion mass, and apply the same formalism to glueball scattering. Our bounds apply to Taylor coefficients and on-shell couplings of the exact planar amplitude. They do not rely on a truncated chiral expansion, so we can follow them as the quark mass varies, and apply them to glueballs, for which no low-energy effective theory exists. For pions, we bound the $O(p^4)$ coefficients and the $\pi\pi f_2$ coupling. As in the chiral limit, the bound on the $\pi\pi f_2$ coupling features a kink, where the extracted spectrum closely resembles the real-world meson spectrum. For glueballs, we bound the couplings of the lightest scalar glueball to heavier glueballs of higher spin, using the large $N$ lattice spectrum as input, and find extremal solutions with linear Regge trajectories.
summary: 我们将π介子散射的大$N$引导扩展到非零π介子质量，并将相同的形式应用于胶球散射。我们的界限适用于泰勒系数和精确平面振幅的壳上耦合。它们不依赖于截断的手性膨胀，因此我们可以随着夸克质量的变化来跟踪它们，并将它们应用于胶球，而胶球不存在低能有效理论。对于π介子，我们限制$O(p^4)$系数和$\pi\pi f_2$耦合。与手性极限一样，$\pi\pi f_2$ 耦合的界限具有扭结，其中提取的光谱与现实世界的介子光谱非常相似。对于胶球，我们将最轻的标量胶球与较高自旋的较重胶球的耦合结合起来，使用大的 $N$ 晶格谱作为输入，并找到具有线性 Regge 轨迹的极值解。

title: Quantum gravity on the bulk cone
abstract: Bulk-cone singularities in holographic correlators encode propagation along bulk null geodesics. The prototypical example is an AdS black hole, where incoming null geodesics can wind around the photon sphere and return to the boundary. These singularities appear in real time in the thermal two-point function at finite volume. We show that conformal field theories dual to gravitational theories at finite $G_N$ cannot have such singularities. We rule out these singularities both for individual microstates and for the thermal state. The main thrust of the argument is to invoke an analytic continuation in the temperature. As a microscopic example, we construct an AdS$_3$ geometry with two colliding shocks which exhibits a bulk cone singularity. We show by an explicit calculation in the CFT that this singularity is smoothed out at finite $G_N$. Qualitatively, the singularity resolution is a consequence of the fuzziness of the bulk solution in quantum gravity.
summary: 全息相关器中的体锥奇点编码沿体零测地线的传播。典型的例子是 AdS 黑洞，其中传入的零测地线可以缠绕光子球并返回边界。这些奇点实时出现在有限体积的热两点函数中。我们表明，在有限 $G_N$ 下，与引力理论对偶的共形场论不可能具有这样的奇点。我们排除了单个微观状态和热状态的这些奇点。论证的主旨是调用温度的解析延拓。作为一个微观示例，我们构建了一个具有两个碰撞冲击的 AdS$_3$ 几何体，该几何体表现出块体锥奇点。我们通过 CFT 中的显式计算表明，该奇点在有限 $G_N$ 处被平滑。定性地讲，奇点分辨率是量子引力中本体解的模糊性的结果。

title: On Born-Infeld-type higher-spin interactions and supersymmetry
abstract: We develop a simple Lorentz-covariant construction of the Born--Infeld-type cubic interactions $(s, s_1, s_2)$ of massless higher-spin fields with $s + s_1 + s_2$ derivatives in four-dimensiona flat space. For arbitrary spins $s \ge s_1 \ge s_2$, the vertex is formulated in terms of a conserved higher-spin current and its trace. In contrast to the famous Berends--Burgers--van Dam currents, these currents are constructed from higher-spin Weyl tensors of a single chirality, schematically $J \sim \partial C \partial C$. Starting with a general ansatz, we derive recurrence relations fixing the current coefficients, identify the unique non-trivial conserved current after eliminating trivial (fake) vertices, and show that in the range $s \le s_1 + s_2$ the interaction admits a manifestly gauge-invariant representation in terms of higher-spin Weyl tensors. The construction is then extended to $\mathcal{N}=1$ and $\mathcal{N}=2$ supersymmetry using the corresponding off-shell superfield formalisms. In the $\mathcal{N}=1$ case, we obtain the general conserved integer superspin $s$ supercurrent with manifest supersymmetry, which is bilinear in the Weyl supertensors of superspins $Y_1$ and $Y_2$. For identical superfields, $Y_1 = Y_2$, this supercurrent vanishes for odd $s$ and is in agreement with earlier results by Gates and Koutrolikos. In the $\mathcal{N}=2$ case, using harmonic superspace, we construct the principal higher-spin supercurrent whose coefficients are uniquely fixed by the conservation equations. In contrast to the $\mathcal{N}=0,1$ cases, for identical $\mathcal{N}=2$ superfields, the corresponding vertex does not vanish. The results provide a systematic framework for Born--Infeld-type higher-spin interactions and their supersymmetric extensions.
summary:
我们开发了无质量高自旋场的玻恩-因费尔德型立方相互作用 $(s, s_1, s_2)$ 的简单洛伦兹协变结构，在四维平坦空间中具有 $s + s_1 + s_2$ 导数。对于任意自旋 $s \ge s_1 \ge s_2$，顶点是根据守恒的高自旋电流及其轨迹来制定的。与著名的 Berends--Burgers--van Dam 电流相反，这些电流是由单手性的高自旋 Weyl 张量构造的，示意性为 $J \sim \partial C \partial C$。从一般的 ansatz 开始，我们推导固定当前系数的递归关系，在消除平凡（假）顶点后识别唯一的非平凡守恒电流，并表明在 $s \le s_1 + s_2$ 范围内，相互作用允许以高自旋 Weyl 张量表示明显的规范不变表示。然后使用相应的离壳超场形式将该构造扩展到 $\mathcal{N}=1$ 和 $\mathcal{N}=2$ 超对称性。

在 $\mathcal{N}=1$ 的情况下，我们得到了具有明显超对称性的一般守恒整数超自旋 $s$ 超流，它在超自旋 $Y_1$ 和 $Y_2$ 的 Weyl 超张量中是双线性的。对于相同的超场，$Y_1 = Y_2$，这种超电流在奇数 $s$ 时消失，并且与 Gates 和 Koutrikos 的早期结果一致。在 $\mathcal{N}=2$ 的情况下，使用调和超空间，我们构造了主要的高自旋超流，其系数由守恒方程唯一确定。与 $\mathcal{N}=0,1$ 情况相反，对于相同的 $\mathcal{N}=2$ 超域，相应的顶点不会消失。结果为玻恩-因费尔德型高自旋相互作用及其超对称扩展提供了系统框架。

title: Onsager Algebras and Lattice Fermions
abstract: We study the exact Onsager algebra of free lattice fermions in staggered, Wilson, and overlap incarnations, working in both Hamiltonian and Euclidean formulations in four spacetime dimensions. In each case, we show that the exact lattice algebra emanates the full chiral symmetry of the low-energy theory: if there are $N$ massless Dirac fermions in the continuum, the Onsager algebra reduces to a $U(2N)$ chiral symmetry. The details of which generators are quantised or ultra-local differ between formulations. There is also a trade-off between the locality of generators and the maximum compact subgroup of the Onsager algebra.
summary: 我们研究交错、威尔逊和重叠形式的自由晶格费米子的精确 Onsager 代数，在四个时空维度上使用哈密顿和欧几里得公式。在每种情况下，我们都证明精确的晶格代数体现了低能理论的完整手性对称性：如果连续体中有 $N$ 个无质量狄拉克费米子，则 Onsager 代数可简化为 $U(2N)$ 手性对称性。哪些生成器是量化的或超局部的，其细节在不同的公式中是不同的。生成元的局域性和 Onsager 代数的最大紧子群之间也存在权衡。

title: Half-Completeness from Standard Gravitational Dispersion Relations
abstract: The completeness hypothesis states that quantum gravity realizes every representation allowed by its gauge group. Previous S-matrix arguments used the graviton pole to constrain exchanged representations, including a proof of completeness by imposing an additional high-energy bound on crossing-odd amplitudes. We investigate what follows without this assumption, using standard twice-subtracted dispersion relations, positivity, and crossing symmetry. For external massless SU(2) isospin $J$, we prove ``half-completeness'': either massive exchanges include every isospin $j\le J$, or at least one $j>J$ is required. At $J=1$, we construct an explicit amplitude with only $j=0,1$ exchanges that satisfies these conditions but violates the crossing-odd bound. This establishes that the additional high-energy assumption does not follow from the standard framework. For $J\ge2$, however, we show that lower-only spectra cannot be realized within a class of string-inspired Euler amplitudes, leaving their existence an open question. More generally, for scalar matter transforming under any compact internal symmetry group, we prove that massive singlets of unbounded Lorentz spin must be exchanged.
summary: 完整性假设指出，量子引力实现了其规范群允许的每一种表示。之前的 S 矩阵论证使用引力子极来约束交换表示，包括通过在交叉奇数振幅上施加额外的高能界限来证明完整性。我们使用标准的两次相减色散关系、正性和交叉对称性来研究在没有这种假设的情况下会发生什么。对于外部无质量 SU(2) 同位旋 $J$，我们证明“半完备性”：要么大规模交换包括每个同位旋 $j\le J$，要么需要至少一个 $j>J$。在 $J=1$ 处，我们构造一个仅具有 $j=0,1$ 交换的显式振幅，满足这些条件但违反了交叉奇数界限。这表明额外的高能假设不符合标准框架。然而，对于$J\ge2$，我们表明仅较低谱不能在一类受弦启发的欧拉振幅中实现，这使得它们的存在成为一个悬而未决的问题。更一般地说，对于任何紧内对称群下的标量物质变换，我们证明必须交换大量无界洛伦兹自旋的单重态。

title: Ricci flow of Integrable Sigma Models, Hitchin Systems and Quantum Seiberg-Witten theory
abstract: We construct a family of integrable 2d sigma models through 4d Chern-Simons theory and show that their classical point-particle reduction corresponds to a Hitchin system. The integrable Hitchin quantisation then provides a natural candidate Hamiltonian for the one-loop reduced dynamics of the sigma models, which coincides with the Perelman operator in all cases examined. This allows us to study the corresponding spectral problems using 4d $\mathcal{N}=2$ gauge theory and 2d conformal field theory methods. For the sausage model, we derive exact quantisation conditions and compute exponentially small corrections essential for the agreement with numerical finite-volume results.
summary: 我们通过 4d Chern-Simons 理论构建了一系列可积的 2d sigma 模型，并表明它们的经典点粒子还原对应于希钦系统。然后，可积希钦量化为西格玛模型的单环简化动态提供了一个自然的候选哈密顿量，这与所有检查情况下的佩雷尔曼算子一致。这使得我们能够使用4d $\mathcal{N}=2$规范理论和2d共形场论方法来研究相应的光谱问题。对于香肠模型，我们推导了精确的量化条件并计算了与数值有限体积结果一致所必需的指数小修正。

title: Alexander Torsion and Floer Comparisons in the BV-BFV Formalism
abstract: We compare relative Abelian BF torsion with the Alexander-graded Euler characteristic of knot Floer homology. A meridional annulus boundary condition identifies the normalized relative torsion with the Alexander polynomial. One exact prime-cyclotomic torsion value recovers all its coefficients under a sharp genus bound, compatibly with connected-sum gluing and branched-cover formulas. We compute interface contractions and obstructions to scalar comparisons, including the pairing defect of two-sector reduction for the degree-zero torus algebra. A six-generator dg resolution yields an equivalence of perfect-module categories preserving derived pairings and admits a classical one-dimensional BV-BFV realization. In the fixed nonresonant polynomial quantum BFV sector, over characteristic zero with $\hbar$ inverted, both states and Weyl observables reduce to a vacuum field; a Hochschild invariant obstructs a Morita equivalence with the degree-zero torus algebra. These results do not establish a full geometric BV-BFV/Floer equivalence.
summary: 我们将相对阿贝尔 BF 挠率与结弗洛尔同调的亚历山大分级欧拉特征进行比较。子午环边界条件用亚历山大多项式识别归一化相对扭转。一个精确的素分圆剖分扭转值可在锐属界下恢复其所有系数，与连通和粘合和分支覆盖公式兼容。我们计算标量比较的界面收缩和障碍，包括零度环面代数的两扇区约简的配对缺陷。六生成器 dg 分辨率产生保留派生配对的完美模块类别的等价性，并允许经典的一维 BV-BFV 实现。在固定非共振多项式量子 BFV 扇区中，在 $\hbar$ 反转的特征零之上，状态和 Weyl 可观测量都减少到真空场； Hochschild 不变量阻碍了 Morita 与零度环面代数的等价。这些结果并未建立完整的几何 BV-BFV/Floer 等价关系。

title: On Borodin-Gorin presentation of Heckman-Opdam $\mathfrak{gl}_n$ hypergeometric function
abstract: We prove that Borodin-Gorin presentation for Heckman-Opdam $\mathfrak{gl}_n$ hypergeometric function by interlacing integrals is equivalent to two other integral presentations studied in arXiv:2508.18864 . We also consider related Baxter operators and the corresponding limiting procedure from the Ruijsenaars hyperbolic model.
summary: 我们通过交错积分证明了 Heckman-Opdam $\mathfrak{gl}_n$ 超几何函数的 Borodin-Gorin 表示等价于 arXiv:2508.18864 中研究的其他两个积分表示。我们还考虑了相关的 Baxter 算子以及 Ruijsenaars 双曲模型中相应的限制过程。

title: Rational limit of Rains integrals of type $A_n$
abstract: We deduce the rational analogue of the elliptic Rains identity of type $A_n$ arXiv:0309252. We also derive reductions of the rational analogue and present the connection of them with well-known integrals in literature.
summary: 我们推导出 $A_n$ arXiv:0309252 类型的椭圆 Rains 恒等式的有理类比。我们还推导了有理类比的约简，并提出了它们与文献中众所周知的积分的联系。

title: Spin-Clifford Bundles and Spin Connections on the Hyperbolic Clifford Algebra - Part I
abstract: We develop the theory of spinor fields associated with the hyperbolic Clifford algebra $\mathbb{R}^{H}=\mathcal{C}\ell(H_V)$, which is associated with hyperbolic space $H_V=V\oplus V^{*}$. Algebraically, we exhibit an explicit real primitive idempotent which, unlike the Lorentzian case, remains primitive after complexification and generates the ideal of Witten superfields. We also describe the chirality decomposition and the hyperbolic spin group. Geometrically, we construct a canonical hyperbolic spin structure on every oriented manifold, showing that no topological obstructions arise beyond orientability and we study the associated spinor bundles, spin-Clifford bundles and ideal spinor subbundles. Finally, we introduce the isotropic extension of an arbitrary linear connection to $TM\oplus T^*M$, which is always compatible with the hyperbolic metric, and the associated hyperbolic spin connection, whose well-definedness, compatibilities, curvature and explicit form are established, providing the geometric framework for Dirac operators on the hyperbolic Clifford algebra, which we will present in a forthcoming article.
summary: 我们发展了与双曲克利福德代数 $\mathbb{R}^{H}=\mathcal{C}\ell(H_V)$ 相关的旋量场理论，该代数与双曲空间 $H_V=V\oplus V^{*}$ 相关。在代数上，我们展示了一个显式的实本原幂等，与洛伦兹的情况不同，它在复杂化后仍然是本原的，并生成理想的维滕超场。我们还描述了手性分解和双曲自旋群。在几何上，我们在每个定向流形上构造了一个正则双曲自旋结构，表明除了可定向性之外不会出现拓扑障碍，并且我们研究了相关的旋量丛、自旋克利福德丛和理想旋量子丛。最后，我们引入了任意线性连接到 $TM\oplus T^*M$ 的各向同性扩展，它总是与双曲度量兼容，以及相关的双曲自旋连接，其明确的定义、兼容性、曲率和显式形式都被建立，为双曲 Clifford 代数上的狄拉克算子提供了几何框架，我们将在即将发表的文章中介绍。

title: First-order differential constraints for the nonlinear wave equation:wave fronts, admissible nonlinearities and exact solutions
abstract: We construct exact solutions of the nonlinear wave equation in three space dimensions by the method of linear determining equations: first-order constraint functions are found as solutions of the linear determining equation, the differential constraints obtained by setting them equal to zero are integrated, and the resulting ansatz is substituted into the equation. Lie point symmetries are a special case, and the solutions obtained generically have no symmetry. The determining equations tie the admissible nonlinearity to the geometry of the constraint: arbitrary on characteristic hyperplanes, cubic on light cones, and, for a pair of constraints, exponential on light cones and quintic on the cylindrical fronts of a line source. Among the solutions are smooth bounded sine-Gordon walls and vortex configurations whose shape varies arbitrarily along a front, the fields of point sources moving on arbitrary trajectories for the cubic and Liouville equations, with an exact nonlinear analogue of the Larmor formula for the power radiated in the cubic case, and smooth finite-energy solutions of the cubic equation with any prescribed number of toroidal nodal surfaces.
summary: 我们通过线性确定方程的方法在三个空间维度上构造非线性波动方程的精确解：找到一阶约束函数作为线性确定方程的解，将通过将其设置为零而获得的微分约束进行积分，并将所得的 ansatz 代入方程中。谎言点对称性是一种特殊情况，获得的解一般不具有对称性。确定方程将允许的非线性与约束的几何形状联系起来：特征超平面上的任意非线性，光锥上的三次约束，以及对于一对约束，光锥上的指数约束和线源的圆柱前端上的五次约束。其中的解包括形状沿前沿任意变化的光滑有界正弦戈登壁和涡旋配置、三次方程和​​刘维尔方程在任意轨迹上移动的点源场、三次情况下辐射功率的拉莫尔公式的精确非线性模拟，以及具有任意指定数量的环形节点表面的三次方程的光滑有限能量解。

title: A sharp gradient-corrected Lieb--Thirring inequality in one dimension with applications to density functional theory
